name: opt_multi_instance1.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (a Ref)(b Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptMI (mk-OptMI (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptMax (mk-OptMax (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptMin (mk-OptMin (x Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-OptMI (sel-OptMI OptMI))
  (lift-OptMax (sel-OptMax OptMax))
  (lift-OptMin (sel-OptMin OptMin))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptMI ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptMI (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptMI ((this Ref)) OptMI
  (sel-OptMI (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptMax ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptMax (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptMax ((this Ref)) OptMax
  (sel-OptMax (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptMin ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptMin (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptMin ((this Ref)) OptMin
  (sel-OptMin (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptMI ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-OptMI this)
    (deref-is-OptMax this)
    (deref-is-OptMin this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptMax ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OptMax this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptMin ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OptMin this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.a: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!a ((this Ref)) Ref
  (a (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.b: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!b ((this Ref)) Ref
  (b (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class OptMI:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for OptMI.x: ---

(define-fun OptMI!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OptMI this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class OptMax:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for OptMax.x: ---

(define-fun OptMax!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OptMax this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class OptMin:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for OptMin.x: ---

(define-fun OptMin!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-OptMin this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OptMax (TopLevelDeclarations!a this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OptMin (TopLevelDeclarations!b this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptMI:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-OptMI OptMI)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptMI.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptMI!x this) 1)
)

(assert (! (OptMI.inv1 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptMI.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptMI!x this) 10)
)

(assert (! (OptMI.inv2 1) :named _xkassert3))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptMax:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-OptMax OptMax)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptMax.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptMax!x this) 1)
)

(assert (! (OptMax.inv1 2) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptMax.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptMax!x this) 10)
)

(assert (! (OptMax.inv2 2) :named _xkassert5))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptMin:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-OptMin OptMin)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptMin.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptMin!x this) 1)
)

(assert (! (OptMin.inv1 3) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptMin.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptMin!x this) 10)
)

(assert (! (OptMin.inv2 3) :named _xkassert7))




; ================================
; === Optimization Objectives: ===
; ================================

(minimize (+ (- (let ((this 2)) (OptMax!x this))) (let ((this 3)) (OptMin!x this))))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-OptMI const-1-OptMI))
        2 (lift-OptMax const-2-OptMax))
        3 (lift-OptMin const-3-OptMin))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (b (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OptMin a!1)))
(define-fun const-2-OptMax () OptMax
  (mk-OptMax 10))
(define-fun const-3-OptMin () OptMin
  (mk-OptMin 1))
(define-fun const-1-OptMI () OptMI
  (mk-OptMI 1))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OptMax (select heap 2))) 1))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 3))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OptMin (select heap 3))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OptMI (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OptMax (select heap 2))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OptMax a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-OptMI (select heap 1))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-OptMin (select heap 3))) 1))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2 3)))
                  1
                  (lift-OptMI (mk-OptMI 1)))))
  (store (store a!1 2 (lift-OptMax (mk-OptMax 10)))
         3
         (lift-OptMin (mk-OptMin 1)))))
